slots.label: Hearthglass
slots.effect: Recover 2 HP when a direct attack slays a natural hostile foe.
slots.tradeoff: Only 1 base guard. Summons, allies and hazards give no healing.

slots.label: Hearthglass Boots
slots.effect: Hearthglass family: three equipped pieces turn excess kill healing into up to 4 ward.
slots.tradeoff: No speed bonus. Three pieces take +1 incoming melee damage.
